transcript: Speaker A: Vani, Metro Mein Ladki Ko Bola, Please Adjust Me. [Vani, I told a girl in the metro, "Please adjust me."] Speaker B: Tum Machine Ho Kya? Can You Make Some Room? Bolte Hain. Aaj Chappal Padne Se Bacha Hai. [Are you a machine? They say "Can you make some room?". Today you were saved from getting hit by a slipper.] Speaker A: Meri English Hamesha Beizzati Karwati Hai Yar. [My English always embarrasses me, man.] Speaker B: Toh SpeakEasy App Par Aao. Main Tumhari AI Tutor Hoon. Mere Sath Bina Sharm Ke Roz Practice Karo. Beizzatti Se Bacho. Neeche Click Karke SpeakEasy App Abhi Download Karo. [Then come to the SpeakEasy App. I am your AI tutor. Practice with me daily without shame. Avoid embarrassment. Click below to download the SpeakEasy App now.] Speaker C: Abhi SpeakEasy App Download Karein Aur Farratedar English Bolna Shuru Karein. [Download the SpeakEasy App now and start speaking fluent English.]
